hero.question: Will the Democrats win the Michigan Senate race in 2026?
hero.prob_take: At 77.5%, the crowd is pricing Democrats as heavy favorites in a state where they've won every statewide race since 2018, but that assumes the structural headwinds facing incumbents in 2026 don't apply to Senate seats the way they do presidential years.
